content_sections.heading: About ICMR-NIRWoH
content_sections.text: ICMR-National Institute for Research on Women's Health is located at Parel, Mumbai. The post is for MRHRU Vani, a unit set up under a Central Sector Scheme funded by the Department of Health Research. The unit works on population-based health surveys, life-course cohort studies and implementation research, with Hematology and Nutrition OPDs among its activities.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: Only one post is available. The selected candidate will be appointed either as Project Research Scientist-II (Medical) or Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical), depending on eligibility, qualifications, experience and suitability for the position.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: MBBS with three years' post-qualification experience, OR MBBS with Post Graduate Degree such as MD/MPH or equivalent degree, including integrated PG degree, OR MBBS with PhD. Post Graduate Degree, including integrated PG degree, in Life sciences/Biotechnology/Biostatistics/Social Sciences with three years' post-qualification experience, OR PhD in Life sciences/Biotechnology/Biostatistics/Social Sciences. Experience in public health, epidemiology, population health, implementation research or community-based research. Experience of working in rural/tribal populations. Experience in project coordination and supervision of research teams. Knowledge of research methodology, ethics and regulatory documentation. Experience in data management and statistical analysis. Research publications in indexed journals. Experience in qualitative/mixed-methods research will be an advantage. The age limit printed for the post is 40 years. The notice does not print a date for counting age or any age relaxation. Candidates meeting the eligible qualification should only apply. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated remuneration for a Medical candidate is Rs 88,000 (Rs.80,000/- plus 10% HRA). For a Non-Medical candidate it is Rs.67,000/- plus 10% HRA; the total printed in the notice for this post, ₹73,7000, is not clearly readable. The post is to be filled on a purely temporary basis for one year, extendable based on satisfactory performance and availability of funds.

content_sections.heading: ICMR-NIRWoH Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Work under the supervision and guidance of the Nodal Team, MRHRU Vani, and assist in the scientific, field and operational activities of the Unit. Assist the Nodal Officer and Nodal Team in planning, implementation, coordination and monitoring of research projects and scientific activities of MRHRU Vani. Support implementation of the Population-Based Health Survey (PBHS), life-course cohort studies, locally relevant research, implementation research and other population-based studies. Assist in development of research protocols, study tools, SOPs, ethics documents, research proposals, progress reports, scientific presentations, manuscripts and publications. Coordinate, as instructed by the Nodal Team, with ICMR-NIRWoH, DHR, Public Health Department, Government of Maharashtra, MUHS, GMC Dhule, SHSRC Maharashtra, district health authorities, health facilities and other collaborating institutions. Support and coordinate field and facility-based research activities, including Hematology and Nutrition OPDs, participant recruitment and follow-up. Undertake data management, quality checks, analysis, interpretation and preparation of study reports, and maintain research records and documentation. Supervise the work of MRHRU project staff and ensure adherence to approved study protocols, timelines, informed consent procedures and data quality. Undertake regular monitoring visits to study sites and support administrative, logistical and operational requirements. Perform any other scientific, technical, field, administrative or project-related work assigned by the Nodal Officer/Nodal Team, MRHRU Vani.

The notice names no documents to be attached.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications received within the deadline will be screened on the eligibility criteria and relevant experience. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for online interview and/or personal discussion, as decided by the Selection Committee. The date, time, mode and other details will be communicated to shortlisted candidates through email. The notice also says the interview may be physical or online.
